GPS Impact Observatory

If GPS claims impact, it must measure it — openly. The Observatory is the platform that will hold us to it.

Will track

Impact indicators

Knowledge, policy, and implementation KPIs — published openly, updated continuously.

Will track

Monitoring & evaluation

M&E systems across every GPS program, from fellowships to labs.

Will track

Policy tracking

Frameworks following briefs and advisory work into actual decisions.

Will track

Implementation assessment

Tools assessing whether pilots scale — and what happens when they do.

Progressive activation

Designed as an expandable platform

This page becomes the Observatory itself: live dashboards, indicator explorers, and public datasets will load right here as the platform comes online by 2029. Until then, founding-year metrics live on the Impact page.
